detail.statement: forall f m n : Nat, bitwise f m n = bitwise f n m (no hf : forall a b, f a b = f b a)
detail.provenance: CLAUDE.md Gotchas, 'Nat.mul HAS THE SAME ASYMMETRY': 'the unconditional form is false whenever f false true = true (so for or and xor, and true only for and)' -- and the fully unconstrained forall-f statement is false for ANY non-commutative f regardless of that boundary detail, which f=fst demonstrates directly and is the witness this fixture uses
